_about: Batch B9 writer (sampler, speculative decoding, DSpark, DFlash). Reuse ids from tours.json (logits, logprob, speculative-decoding, draft-token, mtp, dflash, sampling-params) and the other files; do not redefine them here.

temperature.short: A sampling setting. The sampler divides the logits by it before softmax. A low value makes the most likely token more likely; a high value makes the choice more random.
temperature.long: DeepInfer replaces a temperature below 1e-5 with 1e-5 and turns off top-p and top-k ({{cite deepinfer/sampling_params.py:76-79}}).

top-k.short: A sampling filter. It keeps only the k most likely tokens of a row and gives the other tokens zero probability. top_k = -1 keeps all tokens.

top-p.short: A sampling filter (nucleus sampling). It keeps the most likely tokens until their probabilities add up to more than p. In DeepInfer a token stays if the tokens before it sum to p or less. top_p = 1.0 keeps all tokens.

seq-seed.short: The 64-bit random seed of one request. The sampling kernels mix it with the token position, so the same seed and the same inputs give the same tokens.
seq-seed.long: If you do not give a seed, SamplingParams makes a random one ({{cite deepinfer/sampling_params.py:85-91}}).

force-topk.short: A speed option (DEEPINFER_SAMPLER_FORCE_TOPK). The sampler keeps only the N largest logits of each row and does all later work on those N columns.

rejection-sampling.short: The accept or reject rule of speculative decoding. It keeps a draft token with probability min(1, q/p), so the output follows the target model distribution q (in DeepInfer, up to a very small bounded error).

residual-distribution.short: After a rejected draft, the sampler draws the token from max(q - p, 0), normalized. This adds back the probability that the draft model gave too little. DeepInfer uses max(q - alpha * p, 0) with alpha = exp(-5e-5).

bonus-token.short: The extra token that the target model samples in the last row of a request when the sampler accepts all drafts. One step then makes drafts + 1 tokens.

golden-tokens.short: Teacher forcing: a fixed list of output tokens (golden_token_ids). The sampler outputs these tokens instead of its own samples, and accepts a draft only if it matches.

mtp-info-pool.short: Device memory that keeps the draft tokens, their logprobs and their confidences of each request from one step to the next. Slot 0 holds placeholder drafts.

confidence-head.short: A small layer of DFlash. It predicts, for each draft token, the probability that the target model accepts it (a number from 0 to 1).

markov-head.short: A low-rank correction in the DFlash output head. It adds logits that depend on the previous draft token, so each draft depends on the draft before it.

dspark.short: The speculative decoding design of DeepInfer: the DFlash draft model plus confidence-scheduled verification, which sends fewer drafts for requests whose drafts will probably fail.

verification-length.short: The number of query tokens of a request in a decode step (seqlen_q): 1 real token plus the drafts that the step checks. Without DSpark it is 1 + 5 = 6.

prompt-logprobs.short: The logprob of each prompt token, given the tokens before it. A request asks for them with SamplingParams(prompt_logprobs=True).
